Lecaro is an asteroid orbiting Infernis, on the surface it seemed like not more than a volcanic wasteland. But deep inside there was a large deposit of crystalline wonders. Very attractive to the many mining companies in the region. Unfortunately they were not prepared enough for the dangers of this asteroid.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Suffocated.

CONDITIONS: Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life.

FAUNA: A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.

> Weather

Lecaro can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Hallowed weather by default.

When Lecaro experiences Rainy weather, steam will be visible on the exterior.

When Lecaro experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Lecaro you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Stalagmites & Gunpowder Barrels

Lecaro's exterior always spawns a shovel behind the ship to break Lecaro's unique map hazard, "Stalagmite", which one always spawns behind the ship as well. These Stalagmites can also be broken with a knife and a Pickaxe, a shovel variant and custom scrap Wesley's Moons adds, breaks them in one hit. To the right of the main entrance there are large gunpowder barrels that explode when hit with a knife or shovel. Many more Stalagmites and gunpowder barrels can be found within the interior, but the gunpowder barrels in the interior are lit when hit instead of exploding immediately.

Minecart

Lecaro's exterior has a minecart to the right of the main entrance that can be used to transport players and scrap between the main entrance and the ship. While the lever at the main entrance can be pulled to have the minecart travel in either direction, there isn't a lever at the ship and the player instead interacts with and pushes the minecart back to the main entrance. There is a geyser underneath and between a gap in the tracks that triggers any time a player is detected above it that rapidly deals 69,420 damage per hit to players to prevent simply running and jumping across the tracks instead.

Falling Rocks

Lecaro's exterior has large rocks that spawn in fixed positions that, for the most part, randomly fall when a player walks underneath it. This will crush any player underneath it for 999 damage and block off that path for the rest of the day as these rocks can not be broken.

Stalactites Within The Interior

Numerous stalactites will spawn above or on the roof of the interior. These are normally not visible to the player, but can be seen in interiors with high ceilings like the Grand Armory. When a player walks underneath a stalactite, there is a chance it will begin falling and the roof will shake and scatter dust as a warning. It will then fall into the interior and any player underneath it will be crushed for 999 damage. This will then create a Stalagmite as an obstruction, which can be broken as usual.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Interacting with the map found on the exterior of Atlantica.

Unlocks

Thalasso: Once the stalagmite is broken, stick to the right. Get past the river of lava and keep right. Before reaching the fire exit, there will be a small opening on the left with the map. Interacting with this map will cause a short cutscene and unlock Thalasso. Note that a rock will fall on top of the map shortly after the cutscene, crushing the player.

Hyve: Once the stalagmite is broken, hug the left wall until getting back outside, head up the hill on the right, and a hive will be straight ahead on a different rock. This is also near one of the fire exits. A jetpack or extension ladder is required to reach the hive and breaking it reveals the Hyve videotape.
Oldred: Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Map of Thalasso

Somewhere in caves of Lecaro there is a map on the ground that you can interact with. When you proceed to do so a strange audio will play. Aftar that Thalasso will be unlocked for you.

Image & Text ⁠
Below the ocean surface, deep in the drowning chamber, a secret tunnel remains, in the temples of Thalasso.

Explorer's Notes

Explorer's Note 1

Image & Text ⁠
It has not been a couple hours since I entered this abandoned mineshaft. And already something feels off. If not for the missing equipment in the supply area, it would be the distant rumbling giving me a sense of unease. Maybe I should just shrug it off and get what I came here for.
A large deposit of various crystals is what attracted me to this place.
I've been short on money and I'm slowly heading into debt. If I'm able to find what I'm looking for it could really help me out. I don't know how deep they are but I know for certain that they're there.
There's no mineshaft here for nothing.
I'm heading in deeper.

Explorer's Note 2

Image & Text ⁠
I was uneased before, now I'm scared.
I have seen some of the equipment scattered around the caverns. Abandoned by whomwever used to work here. Possibly left in an emergency I thought. But then I started seeing bones and bodies.
There were empty birdcages sitting on the floor about an hour back. My theory is that there might be something toxic in the air. Possibly some sort of gas leak. Suffocating everyone who was down here at the time. It could be in the air still.
Either way, I need to make it quick. The rumbling is getting closer. And I do not entertain what that could mean.

Explorer's Note 3

Image & Text ⁠
The earthquakes are getting louder and I can hear parts of the cavern collapsing in the distance ahead of me.
The amount of bodies I have seen have left me horrified. While some of them were slumped over. Others looked like they were trying to run.
It's getting harder for me to breathe. And my legs are getting tired.
I have found a few crystals of value. Not many but I should not succomb to my greed. This deposit is lost and I don't want to die trying to find it.
I'm turning around and heading back. I want to see my cat Bean again.
I just need to remember the way I came.
